players.product: QCT single-molecule NGS (smNGS) prenatal (UNITY) and oncology (Northstar) cell-free DNA tests with proprietary algorithms

quarterly_data.signal: Lab capacity expansion (8-K Item 1.01): on June 23, 2026 BillionToOne signed a 12-year lease for approximately 62,659 square feet of office and laboratory space at 3260 Whipple Road, Union City, California, to add laboratory capacity for anticipated growth in test volumes, as total test volumes have exceeded the company's plan over the last year. The laboratory space will be dedicated to oncology products, more than tripling the current oncology-dedicated laboratory space, and will expand total facility space by approximately 16%. The lease is anticipated to commence on or about August 1, 2027, after tenant improvements are completed.
quarterly_data.figure: approximately 62,659 square feet; oncology lab space more than tripled; total facility space +~16%; commencement ~August 1, 2027
